name: Alert scope
description: Who the alert is meant to reach, using the same codes as CAP 1.2 (OASIS). This field is required because sending a restricted or private alert to a public endpoint defeats the whole point of marking it that way.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Restricted
hasDefinedTerm.description: Only people who share a specific, known need can see it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Private
hasDefinedTerm.description: Only the people it's addressed to can see it.
